name: 27-28 DOMINOES
description: 27-28 dominoes refers to block or draw domino games using a standard double-6 set of 28 tiles (0-0 through 6-6). Players draw 7 tiles each (4 players); highest double leads. Players match a number on an open end; doubles are placed crosswise. Cannot play: draw from boneyard or pass. First to empty hand wins and scores sum of opponents' pips; or lowest hand wins if blocked.

Players match a number on an open end; doubles are placed crosswise. Cannot play: draw from boneyard or pass. First to empty hand wins and scores sum of opponents' pips; or lowest hand wins if blocked.

Domino tiles were first recorded in Song-dynasty China, but modern double-6 domino sets and the 27–28 tile block/draw family emerged in 18th-century France and spread through Europe and North America.
Draw 7 each (4 players); remainder is boneyard.
